id: # LoRA pilot (2026-11-19): a training set for a product LoRA, made with ComfyQ's own cards. One product shot of an invented wristwatch from words (no brand, no text on it), then the same watch in other views, places, hands and light from three editors (Qwen Image 2.1, FLUX.3 Klein distilled, MiniMax-H3-Image), every one chained from the first shot so the design does not drift edit after edit. Runs keep runtime.json; this suite is not seeded as examples.

caption: The watch from words.
prompt: A studio product photograph of a wristwatch on a light grey seamless background, three-quarter view from slightly above. The case is cushion-shaped, a rounded square about 40 mm wide, in matte bead-blasted grey titanium with a thin polished bevel around the crystal. The dial is sage green with a fine vertical brushed texture, applied rectangular silver hour markers, no numerals, no text and no logo anywhere. Slim sword-shaped silver hands, the hour hand tipped in bright orange, and a small sunken seconds subdial at 6 o'clock. A slightly domed sapphire crystal, a ribbed crown at 4 o'clock. A woven burnt-orange fabric strap with a small grey titanium buckle. Soft diffused light, crisp detail, 100 mm macro lens.

Keep the cushion-shaped grey titanium case, the sage-green brushed dial, the silver markers, the orange-tipped hour hand, the seconds subdial at 6 o'clock, the crown at 4 o'clock and the burnt-orange woven strap exactly the same.
